newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka frees Tamil girl deported from Denmark.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka frees Tamil girl deported from Denmark.

text.p: A Colombo court on Thursday freed an 18-year-old Sri Lankan Tamil refugee detained by police on suspicion of having links with separatist Tamil Tiger rebels, her lawyer said.
"She was released after 19 days in detention because there were no charges against her," said Gowrysangary Thavarasa.

Chitra Rajendran was deported on November 2 from Denmark, where she had sought asylum three years ago, and was detained by police in Colombo on suspicion of having links with rebel Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE).
The deportation caused an outcry among Danish human rights activists and the Tamil community in Denmark.
The government last week deported four Danish journalists who arrived in Colombo to follow Rajendran's case because they had not sought accreditation, the Defence Ministry said.
Ole Hoff-Lund of the Berlingske Tidende newspaper, Morten Jastrup of Information newspaper, Nis Olsen of Politiken and Jens Moeller of Danish TV2 were detained at a hotel for several days.
The LTTE is fighting a war, now in its 14th year, for a separate Tamil state in the north and east of the Indian Ocean island that has cost 50,000 lives, according to government estimates.
